line: Crowley's Nine of Disks is the card for the second decan of Virgo, with Venus as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Virgo.

quotes.quote: The Nine of Disks is called Gain.
The card is ruled by Venus in Virgo.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: It shows good luck attending material affairs, favour and popularity.
